verdict.rationale: DPMA is the German government patent and trade mark office, and its core offering is official register, search and filing services run by that authority. Self-hosting a sovereign IP registry is a category error, not a capability a buyer could reasonably expect. The downloadable DPMAdirektPro software is a client tool for preparing filings, not a self-hostable instance of the core service, so it does not make the axis applicable.
